required_evidence: Construct the effective quotient in the specified category of sheaves and establish its coequalizer universal property.
Identify the supplied relation with the actual kernel pair of the quotient map.
Prove stability after pullback along any condensed object X, and explain how compatible local records yield quotient records.
critical_errors: Compute the quotient only pointwise as a presheaf and silently treat it as the sheaf quotient.
Claim that every continuous map U→S lifts globally to T merely because T→S is a profinite surjection.
Prove base-change stability only for representable bases while claiming the result for arbitrary condensed bases.
Use a pointwise choice of lifts as if it were continuous.
Change the fixed probe universe or use a larger probe without checking its size.
completion_policy: Completion requires effectiveness and arbitrary-condensed-base stability in the stated universe. Accept any valid sheaf-theoretic or direct descent proof. The beta-N counterexample is an optional boundary witness and is not required if no stronger pointwise claim is made.
open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples and unexpected results. Explicit conditional results are valid contributions but do not by themselves settle the original scope. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
